headline: 98+ contracts catalogued across 37+ supported chains; core governance token, treasury multisigs, and vault infrastructure identified
short_headline: 98+ contracts across 37+ chains; 28 treasury multisigs + governance token

findings.text: Etherscan search identified new BIFI token (0xb1f1ee126e9c96231cc3d3fad7c08b4cf873b1f1) on Ethereum and deprecated BIFI token (0x5870700f1272a1adbb87c3140bd770880a95e55d); DelegateRegistry for voting delegation at 0x469788fE6E9E9681C6ebF3bF78e7Fd26Fc015446.

Official deployments documentation at https://docs.beefy.finance/additional-resources/contract-addresses lists 28 treasury multisig addresses across Arbitrum, Aurora, Avalanche, Base, BSC, Canto, Celo, Cronos, Ethereum, Emerald, Fantom, Fuse, Harmony, HECO, Kava, Metis, Moonbeam, Moonriver, Optimism, Polygon, zkSync Era, and multi-chain treasuries (8 additional treasury entities).

Audit repository at https://github.com/beefyfinance/beefy-audits contains 13 audit reports: DefiYield Vault (2020-12), CertiK Vault (2021-03, 2021-05, 2021-06), Zellic Wrapper (2023-08), Zellic BIFI Token (2023-08), OpenZeppelin Zap (2023-12), Zellic CLM (2024-02), Cyfrin CLM (2024-04), Certora CLM (2024-06), Sherlock CLM (2024-07), Electisec beS (2025-04).

GitHub repositories identified: https://github.com/beefyfinance/beefy-contracts (vault and strategy contracts) and https://github.com/beefyfinance/beefy-protocol (core protocol contracts). Both reference deployment scripts and configuration files indicating multichain deployments across 40+ chains.

Protocol operates on 37 named chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Fraxtal, Binance, Optimism, Polygon, Fantom, Avalanche, Cronos, Monad, Plasma, Metis, Sonic, Linea, xDai, Lisk, RSK, Berachain, Kava, Moonbeam, Moonriver, Fuse, Celo, Aurora, zkSync Era, MegaETH, Mantle, Mode, Oasis, Harmony, Sei, Scroll, Hyperliquid L1, Heco, Saga, Canto, re.al, Manta, Polygon zkEVM). Treasury multisigs and token deployments on each chain to be confirmed via per-chain explorer searches.

Protocol architecture includes vault and strategy factories across chains; Beefy API documents vault enumeration endpoints but discovery capped at 481 tracked pools per DefiLlama integration. Factory child enumeration deferred pending contract-level reads.

Role taxonomy: Native $BIFI Token (token), Treasury Multisigs (treasury), DelegateRegistry (governance/governance-utility), Vault and Strategy Contracts (vault, pool, router). Actor classes: token = unknown/likely eoa-controlled on origin; multisigs = multisig (counted 28 per-chain); governance = governance.
All addresses traced to fetched URLs: contract addresses doc, Etherscan verified token pages, GitHub audit repo, and official docs. No snippet-only sightings without URL sourcing.

rationale.verdict: Systematic discovery of Beefy's core control and token infrastructure across 37 named chains. Primary findings: (1) New BIFI token (0xb1f1ee126e9c96231cc3d3fad7c08b4cf873b1f1) on Ethereum with ERC20Upgradeable architecture; (2) 28 per-chain treasury multisigs listed in official docs; (3) Governance delegation via Snapshot-compatible DelegateRegistry; (4) 13 audits spanning 2020–2025 covering vault, token, CLM, and wrapper contracts; (5) 40+ chain deployment footprint with vault/strategy factories per chain. Downstream evaluation slices (control, ability-to-exit, autonomy, verifiability) inherit these addresses for multisig threshold analysis, timelock configurations, and proxy upgrade authority verification.

Etherscan verified contract for new BIFI token at 0xb1f1ee126e9c96231cc3d3fad7c08b4cf873b1f1 (Ethereum). Contract is ERC20PermitUpgradeable with initialize function minting 80,000 BIFI to treasury address 0xfA9dA51631268A30Ec3DDd1CcBf46c65FAD99251. Deprecated old BIFI token listed at 0x5870700f1272a1adbb87c3140bd770880a95e55d with migration note.

DelegateRegistry governance contract deployed at 0x469788fE6E9E9681C6ebF3bF78e7Fd26Fc015446 on Ethereum, supporting Snapshot delegation space 0x626565667964616f2e657468 (beefydao.eth). Contract manages voting power delegation across all chains where BIFI token is deployed.

BIFI token documentation confirms 80,000 fixed-supply token, two-revenue-stream architecture via BIFI Vault (mooBIFI) and BIFI Pool (rBIFI), and governance voting via Snapshot at 1 vote per token. Token minted to treasury, no additional mint authority, governance address burned post-distribution.

Public repository for community-developed vault and strategy contracts. References deployment scripts, hardhat-deploy configs, and factory patterns for cross-chain vault deployment. Address book referenced in deployment instructions for owner transfers per chain.

Protocol documentation confirms architecture: vaults + strategies for yield farming, revenue bridge contracts for fee distribution, fee batch contract on Ethereum, and stakeholder incentive programs. Multiple service layers including web app (app.beefy.com), APIs, and live servers for cross-chain vault data.

protocol_metadata.about: Beefy is a decentralized, multichain yield optimizer that automates yield farming across 40 blockchains. The protocol allows users to deposit crypto assets into vaults that execute yield-generating strategies through automated reinvestment (autocompounding), earning compound interest with minimal effort. The BIFI token (80,000 fixed supply) serves as the governance and revenue-sharing token, allowing holders to vote on protocol decisions via Snapshot and earn a share of protocol revenues through staking in BIFI Vault or BIFI Pool. The protocol operates across 37+ chains with treasury multisigs managing protocol assets and revenue distribution.
